patches.old_text: Stripe Billing Dashboard analytics tracks recurring revenue metrics. Configurable definitions, drill-down exploration, product/price filtering, and 3 downloadable CSV reports. Benchmarking against similar businesses available.
patches.new_text: Stripe Billing Dashboard analytics tracks recurring-revenue, subscriber, trial, churn, retention, and usage metrics. It offers configurable definitions, scoped drill-downs and filtering, metric-level CSV exports, and three listed prebuilt CSV reports in live mode. See [[source-stripe-billing-analytics]] for the 2026-05-13 and 2026-11-07 variants.
patches.reason: Include the newly documented export distinction and avoid implying all Dashboard features are universally available.

patches.old_text: **Excluded from MRR**: trials, taxes, free plans, metered/usage-based products.
patches.new_text: **Excluded from ordinary MRR**: taxes, free plans, and metered products. For item-level trial offers, only trialing items are excluded; non-trial items in a mixed subscription still contribute. A legacy `trial_end` free trial excludes the whole subscription during the trial. See [[source-stripe-billing-analytics]] (2026-11-07 lines 111–115); the 2026-05-13 capture used subscription-level trial language.
patches.reason: Prevent a false zero-MRR answer for a partly trialing item-level offer.

patches.old_text: `trials converted ÷ trials ended (last 30 days)` — can exceed 100% if conversions happen after trial end.
patches.new_text: `trials converted ÷ trials ended (last 30 days)` — can exceed 100% if conversions happen after trial end. Item-level trial offers count new trials and conversions per trialing subscription item; legacy `trial_end` counts at the subscription level. See [[source-stripe-billing-analytics]] (2026-11-07 lines 199–209; 2026-05-13 lines 163–172).
patches.reason: Restore the counting identity for trial offers and legacy trials.

patches.old_text:
## Downloadable CSV reports

| Report | Contents |
|---|---|
| MRR per subscriber per month | MRR per subscriber at month end |
| Subscription metrics summary | MRR roll-forward, subscriber roll-forward, trial conversion, LTV |
| Customer MRR changes | Log of every MRR change (new/upgrade/downgrade/reactivation/churn) |
patches.new_text:
## CSV exports and prebuilt reports

The 2026-11-07 capture distinguishes individual-metric exports, whose summary tables reflect selected date range, filters, grouping, and comparison, from live-mode prebuilt reports with fixed schemas. Data-result rows are available only for supported metrics. Prebuilt report dates use UTC; charts use the account time zone. See [[source-stripe-billing-analytics]] (new lines 40–65).

| November 2026 prebuilt report | Listed contents |
|---|---|
| MRR per subscriber per month | MRR per subscriber at month end |
| Subscription metrics per month | MRR and subscriber roll-forwards, retention, customer value |
| Customer MRR changes | Customer MRR change log (new/upgrade/downgrade/reactivation/churn) |

The 2026-05-13 capture instead listed **Subscription metrics summary**, with MRR and active-subscriber roll-forwards, trial conversion, and lifetime value. The later page does not establish that the older report is unavailable elsewhere.
patches.reason: Replace undated old report row with dated new row while retaining historical description and export qualifications.
